title: Hide chart and Show chart put the report chart away and bring it back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Sales in the left menu.
  2. Read the control at the right end of the toolbar.
  3. Click it.
  4. Read the control again and look where the chart was.
  5. Click it again.
  6. Repeat on Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the chart shown the control reads Hide chart; clicking it removes the chart and the table moves up to sit under the toolbar.
  • With the chart hidden the control reads Show chart; clicking it brings the chart back above the table.
  • The table's rows and totals are the same with the chart shown or hidden.
  • The build shows the words as Hide Chart and Show Chart with capital C. Write down the words you see; do not pass or fail on the capitalisation.
